reference_question: Hi my mother lives in New Jersey does Medicaid pay for someone to come to the house to help her
reference_answer: New Jersey Medicaid may cover help with daily activities at home through a personal care benefit when eligibility and assessment requirements are met. Enrollment and a nurse assessment can be relevant. Eligibility cannot be promised from the information given.
text_baseline_answer: Medicaid may cover personal care services at home for qualifying New Jersey members, including help bathing and dressing. Enrollment and assessment requirements apply.
